pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Beside a Giant Slingshot Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck's triangular body, swept feather crest, and pointed beak fill this printable coloring page, with a slingshot and a pig tower behind him. His open beak and sharply angled eyebrows stand out against broad body spaces. The coloring sheet adds smaller areas in the grass, rocks, and tower beams.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck in a Slingshot Facing a Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Chuck in a pulled-back slingshot pouch, facing a tall wooden pig fortress built across a rocky outcrop in the distance. The fortress has stacked platforms, cross-braced crates, and a small peaked roof. Broad hills and clouds surround the narrow timber sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Using His Speed Boost to Smash Through a Wooden Pig Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck uses his speed boost to smash a wooden pig tower in this printable coloring page, sending broken boards flying around three startled pigs. Long motion lines lead toward his pointed beak, while split beams tilt through the scene. The coloring sheet combines an open triangular body with many smaller pieces of debris.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Flying Toward a Minion Pig Suspended Beneath a Balloon Coloring Page
pages.description: A flying Chuck approaches a Minion Pig beneath a balloon in this printable coloring page, with distant cliffs and scattered clouds far below the characters. The pig sits in a plank-sided basket hung from twisted ropes. Large balloon panels and Chuck's triangular outline provide spacious sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Guarding Three Eggs in a Grassy Nest on Piggy Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck guarding three eggs in a grassy nest on Piggy Island, with two pigs peering from behind nearby cover. Palm trees rise above layered cliffs, and wooden beams frame one of the watching pigs. The coloring sheet contrasts smooth egg shapes with pointed nest strands and foliage.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Chasing a Minion Pig Carrying a Stolen Egg Along a Forest Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck chases a Minion Pig carrying a stolen egg along a forest path in this printable coloring page, with dust clouds marking their rapid movement. The egg balances on the pig's head as Chuck follows with his beak open. Tree trunks, rounded bushes, and scattered path stones add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chuck, Red, and Bomb Studying a Castle Map Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck plans an egg rescue with Red and Bomb in this printable coloring page, studying a map on a hill below King Pig's castle. A dotted route circles the castle drawing, while crowned King Pig watches from the distant battlements. The coloring sheet includes flags, lookout pigs, and broad rocky slopes.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Hiding with the Blues Behind a Bush as a Pig Patrol Passes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck hiding with the three Blues behind a leafy bush while two helmeted pigs patrol the path beside a wooden fence. The guards carry long spears below a raised watchtower. Overlapping leaves create many enclosed shapes around the birds, with wider spaces in their bodies on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Confronting King Pig Beside the Stolen Eggs Inside the Pig Fortress Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck confronts King Pig beside three stolen eggs inside the fortress in this printable coloring page, facing the crowned pig near a tall wooden throne. A pig-emblem banner hangs over stacked crates and a barrel. Floorboards, wall planks, and the nest's pointed strands supply smaller details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Toons Chuck Racing Down the Cliff to Catch Red in Chuck Time Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Chuck racing down a cliff to catch Red in Chuck Time, with loose stones and curling dust along the slope. Chuck's swept crest and open beak emphasize his forward movement. Wide cliff faces and rounded clouds surround the smaller rocks and feather details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chuck and the Blues on a Log Obstacle Course Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck leads the Blues through a military obstacle course in this printable coloring page inspired by Full Metal Chuck, hopping over a set of logs. Three tires hang from ropes beside a sloping plank ramp. The coloring sheet mixes broad round bird bodies with narrow rope twists, timber grain, and grassy ground details.

pages.title: Angry Birds Toons Chuck Racing Terence Toward the Finish Line in Run Chuck Run Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck races Terence toward the finish line in this printable coloring page from Run Chuck Run, with both birds surrounded by sweeping motion lines and dust. A rectangular checkered banner stretches between flag-topped posts behind them. Their broad bodies dominate the coloring sheet, while the banner squares and scattered pebbles add smaller sections.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Beside an Egg Nest in a Storm Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck shelters beside the egg nest during a lightning storm in this printable coloring page from Thunder Chuck, tucked beneath an overhanging slab of rock. Three eggs rest among densely woven twigs as rain falls beyond the shelter. Large jagged bolts, rounded clouds, and broad rock surfaces frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Toons Chuck Splitting a Fallen Tree Trunk with a Karate Strike in Chucked Out Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Chuck splitting a fallen tree trunk with a karate strike in Chucked Out, scattering chunks of wood across the ground. Concentric rings mark both cut ends, and rough bark lines run along the broken halves. The coloring sheet balances those small textures with broad tree foliage and distant cliffs.

pages.title: Chuck Planting a Flower with Matilda in a Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck carefully plants a flower as Matilda teaches him in her garden on this printable coloring page, beside a small trowel and a watering can. A picket fence and taller flowers stand behind the two birds. Rounded petals and leaves add smaller shapes among the broad body areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Toons Chuck Photobombing Matilda's Garden Picture Beside Her Instant Camera Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck photobombing Matilda's garden picture, leaning into view behind her beside an instant camera and a freshly printed flower photograph. Large blossoms fill the foreground beneath a tree and picket fence. The coloring sheet includes circular lens rings, narrow leaf sections, and wide spaces across both birds.

pages.title: Chuck Measuring a Broken Slingshot Beside Terence Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck holds a tape-measure case in his beak beside a broken slingshot in this printable coloring page, while Terence watches from behind on the grass. The extended measuring strip reaches toward the splintered wooden fork. Broken bands and scattered fragments add narrow details beside the birds' larger shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Toons Chuck Singing to the Eggs Beside Red and Matilda in Egg Sounds Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck sings to the eggs beside Red and Matilda in this printable coloring page from Egg Sounds, with musical notes floating above his raised beak. Three eggs sit in a leafy nest between the birds. The coloring sheet combines rounded bodies and smooth eggs with thinner twig, leaf, and grass sections.

pages.title: Chuck with Paint on His Crest Beside a Mirror Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck inspecting his paint-covered crest in a standing mirror after the Blues' prank, with three laughing birds behind nearby bushes. An overturned paint can and puddle sit at his side. The coloring sheet repeats his triangular face in the oval mirror and includes drips along the feather tips.

pages.title: Chuck and Bomb Chasing Pigs on Skateboards Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck and Bomb chase egg-stealing pigs through Pig City in this printable coloring page, following two skateboard riders clutching eggs along a curved stone street. Pig-emblem banners hang from tall rounded buildings beside the route. The coloring sheet has smaller details in the skateboard wheels, windows, flags, and paving stones.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Playing a Didgeridoo on the Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck plays a branch-shaped didgeridoo for Bomb and the Blues on the beach in this printable coloring page, with a palm-covered island across the water. The long instrument points into the foreground beside a starfish. Broad sand and bird shapes surround its wood-grain lines and the smaller facial details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck at Dinner with a Curly-Haired Bird Coloring Page
pages.description: A candlelit dinner with Chuck and a triangular rock fills this printable coloring page, showing the rock wearing a curled wig and a painted face. A rose vase, two plates, and stemmed glasses decorate the round table. Curtains and hanging bulbs enclose broad cloth sections and smaller tabletop shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chuck, Red, and Bomb Wearing Pig Helmets Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck, Red, and Bomb sneak toward King Pig's cakes in this printable coloring page, each wearing a stolen pig helmet inside an arched stone hall. Crowned King Pig waits beside a tiered cake and cupcakes behind them. Helmet snouts, frosting scallops, and rounded floor stones create smaller sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Chuck Sprinting Along a Village Street on Bird Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Chuck sprints along a village street on Bird Island in this printable coloring page, with his wings spread and one long leg reaching forward. Rounded houses have leaf-covered roofs and oval windows on either side. The coloring sheet adds feather tufts, stone paving, and a trailing cloud of dust around his broad body.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Chuck Receiving a Speeding Ticket From a Police Bird Beside the Road Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck receiving a speeding ticket from a police bird beside the road, standing next to a car with his wings together. The officer writes in a spiral notepad while wearing a peaked cap and uniform belt. Wheel spokes, badge outlines, and feather edges provide smaller sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Chuck Talking with Red and Bomb in Matilda's Anger Management Class Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck talks with Red and Bomb in Matilda's anger management class on this printable coloring page, gesturing from a chair between the two seated birds. Matilda holds a clipboard behind them beside a lotus drawing on an easel. The coloring sheet includes a circular rug, round window, and long wooden wall panels.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Chuck Practicing a Standing Yoga Pose on a Mat in Matilda's Class Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck practices a standing yoga pose on a mat in this printable coloring page, balancing on one leg while Matilda demonstrates the same pose behind him. Both birds press their wings together beneath a hanging lantern. Rolled mats, bamboo supports, and a leafy plant add smaller details around the open figure shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Chuck Hiking Up Eagle Mountain with Red and Bomb to Find Mighty Eagle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Chuck hiking up Eagle Mountain with Red and Bomb to find Mighty Eagle, who stands above them on the rocky summit. All three hikers carry packs with rolled bedding attached. Angular trail stones, distant pine trees, and layered cliff faces add varied sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Chuck Meeting Mighty Eagle Beside the Lake of Wisdom with Red and Bomb Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck meets Mighty Eagle beside the Lake of Wisdom with Red and Bomb in this printable coloring page, stretching one wing toward the much larger bird. Mighty Eagle stands on a raised rock above the shoreline. The coloring sheet includes layered wing feathers, curved talons, lake ripples, and distant wooded cliffs.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Chuck Speeding Through the Pig Castle Kitchen During the Egg Rescue Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck speeds through the pig castle kitchen during the egg rescue in this printable coloring page, carrying an egg while two pig chefs run behind him. Hanging pans, a vegetable-covered counter, and an egg cart fill the room. Small utensil and tile shapes surround Chuck's larger feathered outline on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck and Silver in a Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck reuniting with his sister Silver in the Avian Academy engineering classroom, with both birds smiling and spreading their wings. An aircraft diagram and gear drawing hang above a workbench with tools. Tall arched windows frame the birds, while feather tips and hardware add smaller coloring sheet details.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie 2 Chuck Examining Garry's Spy Gadgets Inside the Submarine Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck examines Garry's spy gadgets inside the submarine in this printable coloring page, lifting a small device beside an open case of goggles and equipment. A four-rotor drone sits on the floor below a radar screen. The coloring sheet includes riveted portholes, pipes, antennae, and compact gadget compartments around Chuck.

pages.title: Chuck and Bomb Assembling an Eagle Costume Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck and Bomb prepare the giant eagle disguise beside Leonard on Eagle Island in this printable coloring page, arranging feathers around its exposed wooden frame. A loose rope, rolled fabric, and spare feathers lie nearby. The coloring sheet combines long overlapping feather shapes with broad cliffs and an eagle-shaped rock peak in the distance.

pages.title: Chuck Tying Ropes across a Giant Cannon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Chuck tying Silver's superstring across the muzzle of Zeta's giant cannon, stretching several strands from one side of the opening. Zeta watches from behind the large barrel with her beak open. Long string triangles, circular fittings, and broad cannon panels create contrasting sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Space Chuck as Lazer Bird Speeding Toward a Pig on a Cratered Asteroid Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck speeds toward a pig on a cratered asteroid as Lazer Bird in this printable coloring page, wearing angular eye gear and a sharply pointed crest. Smaller asteroids and four-point stars surround the two characters. The coloring sheet has large open body areas alongside rings, crater ovals, and narrow details around the goggles.

pages.title: Chuck in a Wizard Hat Facing Armored Pigs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck as a mage beside his magic staff, facing armored pigs alongside Red the knight near a wooden fort in Angry Birds Epic. Chuck wears a bent pointed hat, and the staff holds a faceted crystal. Spearheads, round shields, and helmet rivets supply smaller details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Wizard Chuck Casting Lightning at Pig Knights Coloring Page
pages.description: Wizard Chuck casts chain lightning between pig knights outside a stone castle in this printable coloring page, aiming his crystal staff toward two startled armored opponents. His oversized pointed hat is covered with stars. The coloring sheet includes jagged lightning paths, crown-marked shields, a raised portcullis, and flag-topped turrets behind the battle.

pages.title: Chuck with a Staff Above Red and Matilda in Rain Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck as Rainbird using healing rain to help Red and Matilda after battle, with droplets falling from a small cloud. Both birds have crossed bandages and scratch marks on their faces. Chuck's feathered headband and winged staff add smaller details above the broad body shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Go Chuck Lining Up His Soapbox Kart in the Starting Slingshot Beside King Pig Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck lines up his soapbox kart beside King Pig in the starting slingshot on this printable coloring page, with both racers seated on a raised platform. A giant wooden fork and stretched bands rise behind their vehicles. Plank bodies, circular wheels, and King Pig's tall crown divide the coloring sheet into clear enclosed sections.

pages.title: Chuck Driving a Kart Through Watermelon Slices Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck driving his kart through watermelon slices and other fruit in a Fruit Splat race, with juice splashes surrounding the wheels. Bananas and a pineapple hang above the wooden track. The coloring sheet includes repeated seed shapes, rind bands, broad tire rings, and smaller panels along the kart.

pages.title: Angry Birds Go Chuck Jumping His Mega-rocket Kart From a Stunt Ramp Above the Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck jumps his Mega-rocket kart from a stunt ramp above the track in this printable coloring page, lifting all four wheels between two high cliffs. A rocket unit and tail fins extend behind his seat. The coloring sheet has large vehicle panels, curved wheel sections, ramp supports, and a winding fenced course below.

pages.title: Chuck in Robot Armor Firing at a Pig Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page portrays Chuck as Bumblebee in robot form, firing at pig defenses on Piggy Island beside a tall wooden tower holding three pigs. Car wheels and angular armor panels form his mechanical limbs. The coloring sheet adds a starburst blast outline, flying fragments, palm trees, and layered rocks around the robot.

pages.title: Chuck as a Car Beside a Collapsing Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck speeds away from a collapsing stone tower as Bumblebee in car form in this printable coloring page, with loose blocks tumbling behind the vehicle. His pointed beak and eyebrows remain visible above the hood. The coloring sheet combines broad curved fenders and tires with narrow vents, headlights, cracks, and scattered stones.

pages.title: Chuck Firing a Blaster at Armored Pigs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck as Han Solo firing his blaster beside Chewbacca at Stormtrooper Pigs, surrounded by wall panels and stacked cylindrical containers. Chuck wears a belted vest, while Chewbacca has a diagonal bandolier. Helmet details, blaster parts, and layered feather outlines add smaller spaces throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Star Wars Chuck as Han Solo Frozen in a Carbonite Slab in Cloud City Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck appears as Han Solo frozen inside a carbonite slab in this printable coloring page, displayed upright within a chamber in Cloud City beneath overhead machinery. His triangular face, swept crest, vest, and belt remain outlined inside the rectangular block. The coloring sheet includes wavy surface shapes, side control units, and broad surrounding wall panels.

pages.title: Chuck Sleeping on a Cloud Swing beneath Dream Bubbles Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Chuck sleeping on a hanging cloud in Angry Birds Dream Blast, surrounded by dream bubbles showing a bird, spheres, and a rainbow. His eyes are closed and his wings rest beneath his face. Twisted suspension ropes and small stars add narrow details around the broad cloud shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Epic Chuck Trapped in a Wooden Cage as Red the Knight Arrives to Rescue Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck is trapped in a wooden cage as Red the knight arrives to rescue him in this printable coloring page, below two pigs watching from a fort. The cage hangs from a knotted rope on a timber support. Red's sword, plumed helmet, and crown-marked shield add smaller sections beside the cage bars on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chuck in a Santa Hat Beside a Snowy Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck wearing a Santa hat beside a decorated Christmas tree and snowy slingshot, surrounded by gently curved banks of snow. Round ornaments and a winding garland hang below the tree's star. The coloring sheet offers broad body and snow areas with smaller sections in the hat trim and decorations.

pages.title: Chuck in a Witch Hat beside Carved Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck wears a pointed witch hat beside carved Halloween pumpkins and a pig tower in this printable coloring page, beneath a large moon partly crossed by clouds. His hat has a broad brim and square buckle. Three pigs, pumpkin ridges, triangular eyes, and jagged carved mouths add smaller shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck Wearing Rabbit Ears and Chasing a Pig Carrying a Decorated Easter Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck wearing rabbit ears and chasing a pig carrying a decorated Easter egg, with dust clouds stretching behind the two characters. The pig balances the patterned egg on its head. Wavy stripes, circles, and narrow ear interiors add smaller sections beside the broad bird and pig shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck in Bamboo Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck stands in a bamboo forest on this printable coloring page, with a swept feather crest, long pointed beak, and wings resting beside his body. Tall segmented stalks and small clusters of narrow leaves surround him. The coloring sheet leaves generous space across his belly and body, with finer areas in the bamboo joints and foliage.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck on Piggy Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Chuck on Piggy Island wearing a knotted neckerchief, with a winding path leading toward a pig perched inside a small tower. Palm trees stand beyond his broad smiling figure. The coloring sheet combines large body and scarf sections with smaller rocks, grass tufts, and tower supports.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck in Egg Nest Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck sits beside three eggs in the egg nest area on this printable coloring page, smiling above an oval nest woven from twigs and leafy branches. His swept crest and tail feathers extend beyond his broad triangular body. The coloring sheet keeps the background open while the overlapping nest strands create many smaller enclosed sections.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck in Glass Tower Area Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck in the glass tower area, smiling among stacked rectangular blocks with several cracked panels and a tall column behind his shoulder. His wing rests across a broken upper edge. Broad face and body spaces contrast with angular cracks, framed panels, and narrow block sides on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck in Piggy Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck stands in Piggy Village in this printable coloring page, with three small pigs watching from beside wooden buildings and a winding path behind him. Two windmills rise above the rooftops and rounded trees. The coloring sheet adds narrow fence rails, crossed roof beams, and grass details around Chuck's larger body and belly sections.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck in City Park Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck in a city park, facing forward with angled eyebrows and one wing raised beside his broad triangular body near two trees. A bench and lamps sit below a simple skyline. The coloring sheet has open body spaces, with smaller sections in the bench slats, leaves, and lamp frames.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck on Riverbank Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck stands on a grassy riverbank in this printable coloring page, with a winding river, distant trees, and a round sun extending behind his large figure. Curved ripple lines surround a stone in the water. The coloring sheet includes smaller blades of grass and shoreline rocks beside broad body, belly, and landscape sections.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck in Cloud Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Chuck on a cloud island, standing on a rounded cloud while two small floating landforms with trees hover in the distance. His triangular silhouette, pointed beak, and swept crest dominate the scene. The coloring sheet leaves broad spaces in his body and cloud, with smaller tree canopies and feet below.

pages.title: Angry Birds Chuck in Asteroid Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Chuck appears in an asteroid field on this printable coloring page, with his beak open and angular eyebrows lowered among scattered stars and irregular space rocks. A circular marking sits within his curved belly patch. The coloring sheet provides broad body spaces alongside smaller star points, pebble outlines, and uneven asteroid surface shapes.
